original_test_intent: Validate that the BMC's enabled one-time PXE boot setting sends the approved SUT through the intended network interface to the approved PXE service and non-destructive boot artifact, including regression 712133 coverage.
original_method: Bind SUT and BMC identity to the intended NIC/MAC/VLAN and UEFI or legacy mode, validate isolated DHCP/PXE service and immutable boot artifact, record baseline boot state, obtain approval, apply/read back the protected one-time PXE override, reboot once, correlate POST, DHCP and PXE logs with console proof of the expected artifact marker, stop before disk writes, then clear the override and restore the normal OS boot.
manual_activity: The owner approves the network boot mapping and reboot; an operator observes POST/console, stops any unintended installer or loop and owns restoration, recovery and verdict.
required_inputs: Intended PXE NIC, MAC, VLAN and link
Isolated DHCP next-server and boot-file mapping
Approved immutable artifact checksum/signature and expected marker
Baseline boot order and current override
safety_requirements: Do not guess NIC, MAC, VLAN, firmware mode or artifact
Use protected credentials and read back one-time state
Never start an installer or disk write without separate approval
Stop on wrong offer, server, artifact, PXE loop, boot failure or timeout
Clear override and restore normal boot
Preserve PXE, audit, SEL and OS logs
agent_execution_scope: Collect boot/network baseline and validate mapping
Verify DHCP/PXE configuration and artifact integrity
Apply/read back one approved one-time PXE setting after confirmation
Request and perform one approved reboot
Correlate structured DHCP/PXE events while operator observes POST/console
Verify override cleanup and normal OS recovery
engineer_actions: Observe the actual PXE path and artifact

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: bootdev pxe may set a generic override but the literal command exposes credentials and immediately resets without mapping NIC/service/artifact, reading persistence or collecting PXE evidence.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Use the vendor-supported protected one-time PXE control, verify readback, then correlate one approved reboot with intended-MAC DHCP/PXE logs and console proof of the signed non-writing artifact.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: Pxe, Enabled/Save, reboot, regression intent and 10/20-minute estimates remain.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Create a timeline linking boot-setting readback, POST NIC identity, DHCP transaction, next-server/boot-file, artifact hash or signed identity and console landmark, followed by consumed-override proof.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Defines specific path as one exact network and artifact chain while preserving direct PXE regression coverage.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: A successful bootdev command or DHCP offer alone cannot prove firmware executed the intended artifact, and console output without server correlation can come from the wrong NIC or cached local boot.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Multiple NICs or proxy-DHCP services can answer differently; a broad production PXE environment may deliver an unintended installer.

project_override_considerations: The Project must name the NIC/MAC/VLAN, boot mode, DHCP/PXE service and safe expected artifact. Installation remains outside scope unless separately authorized.
expected_evidence: Approved target/window, baseline boot state and exact NIC/MAC/VLAN/boot-mode mapping
DHCP/PXE configuration and immutable artifact identity/integrity
Protected one-time PXE write/readback and reboot request
Correlated POST, intended-MAC DHCP/PXE and console timeline proving the approved artifact marker
Proof no unapproved installer or disk write occurred
Override clear, normal OS restoration, health/log evidence and engineer-owned verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Items, procedure, criteria and regression note all point to one-time PXE boot. The unspecified specific path is the project PXE mapping, not a competing source target.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The NIC, PXE service, artifact and recovery package are normal project inputs; the case becomes non-executable until provided but its engineering intent is clear.

review_improvement: Replaces a generic bootdev-reset shortcut with end-to-end evidence that the intended interface reached and executed the intended PXE artifact, then restored safely.
independent_technical_reasoning: PXE boot can fail or misroute after a boot override succeeds because firmware selects another NIC, DHCP class or architecture, or proxy-DHCP supplies a different file. Correlating MAC-scoped server events with POST and a signed artifact landmark is what demonstrates the regression is actually covered.
